name: The Barn by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota

bagPolicy.summary: At Gopher basketball games, only clear tote bags up to 12" x 12" or small bags up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. Backpacks and large bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear tote bags up to 12" x 12"
Small bags up to 4.5" x 6.5" (clutch purses, crossbody bags)
bagPolicy.note: Posted for Gopher men's basketball at The Barn; other events may differ. Medical bags are allowed after a gate supervisor screens and tags them.

parking.summary: Guests using an ADA space must purchase a game-day parking pass for that lot or ramp and display a government-issued ADA placard.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: All concession stands at The Barn are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking requires both a game-day parking pass and government-issued ADA placard. Accessible seating assistance is available through Gopher Athletics.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: During non-event hours, will call is available Monday through Friday at the 3M Arena at Mariucci Ticket Office. On game day, public will call is at the Oak Street entrance.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Oak Street entrance on the east side serves public will call and designated pass gates; other entrance assignments are shown in the event guide.
